protocol.request: HotActivationRequest source epoch/doc/account CAS + target doc/account; no Runs/seed/NextEpoch
protocol.private: OwnerID, random32hex namespace, expectedActivationGeneration, afterRevision=max(current receiver revision, invalid barrier)
protocol.ack: <=8192B strict hotActivated header: ownerID/native-generated unique epoch/doc/account/revision/semanticRevision/digest/activationGeneration/requiresSnapshot=true. No body.
protocol.nativeEpoch: native-hot:<per-Editor random namespace>:<per-owner monotonic uint64 generation>
protocol.metadataRetention: constant namespace + counter only; no epoch set or extra receipt ledger
protocol.preMutation: all source/target/account/selection/integer/header constraints and full ack serialization fit checked before save/restore/identity change; source barrier ahead of native revision rejects without switching
protocol.receiver: Ack adopts binding but always fences; DecodeSnapshot rejects hotActivated even for empty documents. Only complete same-scope valid frame above current barrier may recover. Old source/ack/callback/receipt cannot clear native hot contents.
protocol.errors: Only an explicit whitelist of body-free single error-field native before-mutation rejections is typed ActivationRejected; HOT_DOCUMENT_MISSING alone enables considering cold seed. Unknown/mixed/oversized/malformed acknowledgement quarantines the carrier.
protocol.storeAdapterBoundary: One app UI transaction: successful native ack -> Store.Bind(id,ack.Epoch) -> Store.Fence(id,ack.Epoch,ack.Revision), before any send capture. Never Store.Accept(metadata ack). Main production adapter is not implemented here.

firstReadRegression.fix: public ensureAttributesAreFixed(in:) before all three semantic readers; no extra body copy, polling, repeated read acceptance or semantic source mutation

tests.limits: Programmatic AppKit/current M4 only; no visible GUI, physical IME, macOS15.8 device/M1/RSS claim.

pending: No production adapter/main/default integration and no new signed App.

Cold Store accepted settlement vs still-old Swift hot text needs explicit leave-baseline comparison plus native CAS settlement/rebuild/cut-undo. Invalid/oversize cold settlement defers; neither blind reseed nor stale hot Store.Accept is permitted.
Existing native hot document/Undo retention has no automatic memory budget; nonce metadata itself is constant.
Large native content is retained. Snapshot encoding may allocate its body before producing bounded error header; no streaming export or M1 memory improvement is claimed.
Final independent review and joint whole-component source commit; no partial commit.
